hotels.title: Modern Goulburn Escape at Mercure in the Heart of Town
hotels.description: Set just off the Hume Highway, this contemporary Goulburn stay places you within easy reach of the city’s grand sandstone heritage, with Belmore Park and the Goulburn Regional Art Gallery a short drive away. The Big Merino stands nearby, offering a distinctly Australian roadside landmark and access to local wool history. Onsite, Mercure Goulburn Bar & Grill serves modern Australian fare in a polished setting, with hearty breakfasts and evening dining covered. After exploring the Goulburn Rail Heritage Centre or the gothic beauty of St Saviour’s Cathedral, retreat to sleek rooms appointed with smart TVs, minibars and rain showers
